seo_title: Shopify vs BigCommerce: Headless API & B2B Audit (2026)
meta_description: Technical comparison of Shopify Plus vs BigCommerce Performance for headless GraphQL API limits and B2B wholesale checkout architecture.
direct_verdict: Shopify Plus wins for high-volume headless storefronts requiring massive API throughput and native checkout customization. BigCommerce Performance is superior for complex B2B wholesale requirements where native price lists and customer segmentation are prioritized over custom checkout logic.

comparison_matrix.product_a_spec: Up to 10x standard limits on Plus

comparison_matrix.product_b_spec: Native price lists and customer groups

product_a_pros: Superior GraphQL API throughput for headless builds
Checkout Extensibility allows deep customization of B2B flows
Massive ecosystem of certified apps for complex integrations
product_a_cons: High base cost for Plus entry
Third-party transaction fees persist unless using Shopify Payments
product_b_pros: Native SKU-level price lists reduce need for custom B2B middleware
Lower entry point for enterprise-grade performance plans
Flexible open payment provider options without transaction penalties
product_b_cons: Limited inventory location scaling compared to Shopify
hidden_gotchas: Shopify Plus API limits are often misunderstood; while they offer 10x increases, these are not infinite and require careful bucket management for high-concurrency headless storefronts. BigCommerce's 'Performance' plan pricing is highly variable based on GMV, and the 'Open Payment Provider' fee can silently erode margins if you do not utilize their embedded payment partners. Both platforms enforce strict contract lock-ins for enterprise tiers, making migration out of their respective ecosystems expensive and technically taxing.
